correctness.rationale: On orthonormal vectors supported on antipodal pairs the parity-compatible matrix is twice the ten-axis kernel, and the opposite sector is zero. For the unsigned case, the matrix of the larger absolute angle has row sum 3 and obeys A_v^2=2I-A_v+J, so 3, 1 and -2 have multiplicities 1, 5 and 4 by the trace. For the signed case, B_u has eigenvalues 2 and -3 with multiplicities 6 and 4. The symmetric B_v obeys B_v^2=B_u+3I and commutes with B_u; it vanishes on the -3 space and has eigenvalues ±sqrt(5), each threefold by its zero trace, on the 2 space. These yield exactly the stated branch coefficients. Positivity also follows from the addition theorem, with E_l E_l*=(2l+1)G_l/20 for the specified evaluations. Independently reconstructed the exact angle matrices and their identities, and used the Rodrigues coefficient expansion, not the supplied recurrence, to exhaust degrees 0–185 with the stated eight rank deficiencies. The Laplace integral and sin(s)≥2s/pi on the half interval give |P_l(t)|≤sqrt(pi/[2l(1-t²)]); the maximum branch deviation is bounded by sqrt(pi/l)*(9/2+9/sqrt(8)), strictly less than one for l≥186 by the rational upper bound. Rank nine at 14 and rank ten from 15 onward therefore follow exactly.
residual_risks: Only the finite check and rational tail comparisons were run as code; the Laplace estimate and matrix spectral deductions are analytic.
